# <playbook_cite>Following entry [CORE PRINCIPLE: 'my X' = items you OWN or have in your LIBRARY]</playbook_cite>
# <playbook_cite>Following entry [When operating on ordered or stateful collections, inspect metadata...]</playbook_cite>
# Fetch song details for all unique song_ids from union: song library + album library songs + playlist songs.

# Prepare union list
union_song_ids_list = sorted(union_song_ids)

song_details = {}
# Start with what we already have from song library
for sid, meta in song_library.items():
    song_details[sid] = {'title': meta['title'], 'artists': meta['artists']}

missing_detail_ids = [sid for sid in union_song_ids_list if sid not in song_details]
print('union unique song_ids', len(union_song_ids_list))
print('already have details from song library', len(song_details))
print('missing details to fetch via show_song', len(missing_detail_ids))

# Fetch missing details
errors = []
for i, sid in enumerate(missing_detail_ids):
    try:
        s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        title = s.get('title', '')
        artists = [a.get('name','') for a in s.get('artists', [])]
        song_details[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists}
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append((sid, str(e)))
    if (i+1) % 10 == 0 or i == len(missing_detail_ids)-1:
        print('fetched', i+1, 'of', len(missing_detail_ids))

print('final song_details count', len(song_details))
print('errors', len(errors))
print('errors_sample', errors[:5])

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [A. General instructions: Never invent or guess values — always look them up via APIs.]</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure what ordering the CSV is expected in; will use deterministic ordering by Title then Artists.</uncertainty>

def csv_escape(val):
    s = str(val) if val is not None else ''
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# Build rows
rows = []
for sid, meta in song_details.items():
    title = meta.get('title','')
    artists = meta.get('artists',[])
    artists_field = '|'.join(artists)
    rows.append((title, artists_field))

rows_sorted = sorted(rows, key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower()))

header = 'Title,Artists'
lines = [header]
for title, artists_field in rows_sorted:
    lines.append(csv_escape(title) + ',' + csv_escape(artists_field))

content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print({'unique_songs_count': len(rows_sorted), 'content_lines_total': len(lines), 'content_preview_first_3': lines[:3], 'content_preview_last_3': lines[-3:]})
len_content = len(content)
print('content_length_chars', len_content)
